# Questions and support

Ask questions in [Discussions](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon/bounded-count-identifiability/discussions).
Use issues for reproducible software failures, incorrect mathematical statements
or missing prior-art attribution. Include a commit identifier and a small example.

The maintainer is [Thomas Albrecht](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon).
No private email, consulting service or response-time commitment is provided.
Security reports use [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); conduct concerns use
[the conduct policy](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon/bounded-count-identifiability/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
